product_metadata.title: Jubilantex White Gold Butterfly Shower Curtain for Bathroom Farmhouse Waterproof Bathroom Decorative Rustic Kids Shower Curtain with 12 Rust Proof Grommets for Spa Hotel, 70x76 Inches
features: 【NOVEL DESIGN】- The shower curtain features a beautiful design of golden butterflies that create a stunning visual impact. The butterflies are delicately placed on a white background that makes them stand out and adds a touch of elegance to your bathroom.

【HIGH-QUALITY MATERIAL】- The White shower curtain is made of high-quality fabric. The fabric feeling fabric with very heavy duty, waterproof, Easy to clean up and machine washable.Quick drying, odorless, eco-friendly and thick enough for privacy protection.

【MULTIPLE OCCASIONS】- Jubilantex has gauze curtains and blackout curtains with the same theme, and you can decorate your home with golden butterfly curtains. At the same time, this product is also very suitable for families, apartments, hotels, campers, farmhouses, dormitories, school showers, sports club, and gyms, making your bathroom full of vitality.
【PACKAGE CONTENT】- One Butterfly Shower Curtain in package, which measures 70 by 76 inches. Our 12 durable buttonholes design makes the curtain easy to install and hang up.

【Easy to Maintain】- The shower curtains for bathroom can machine wash in cold water, no fading, gentle cycle, do not bleach, low temperature drying, each metal ring corresponds to a rust-resistant hook, and the rust-resistant metal ring hole makes installation easier.
